responsibility: Provides the scheduler model for the Marvell PJ4 core, covering integer, load/store, branch, multiply/divide, VFP, and selected NEON interactions. It defines issue, completion, ALU, multiply, divide, and VFP resources; instruction reservations and bypasses for scalar integer operations, memory operations, branches and calls; and detailed timing for VFP/core transfers, making it the tuning model for marvell_pj4.
